about: 10 score tables that compute the direction for decision-type worries (v4.6 worry frames). + = the move side, − = the stay side. No zeros. Each table has poles (fixed meaning of + and −) and implicit (2 default options [+, −] used when the worry names no options). v3: removed the generic 'act' table → split into express and boundary; renamed start to 'Starting (Do / Don't)'. mode axis: options_ranked=[+ side, − side] → if sum ≥ 0 use [0], else [1]. mode rank: options_ranked = recommendation order → if sum ≥ 0 the 1st choice [0], else the 2nd choice [1] (3rd and below never become the conclusion).

rule.note: No average (baseline) is subtracted. A sum of 0 goes to the move side.
